dict.Bec cu idei (primul element e ideea, în: Light bulb of ideas (the first item is the idea, in the bulb; the others in boxes to its left and right, linked to the bulb by rays)
dict.Ideea în becul din mijloc, iar ce porneș: The idea in the bulb in the middle, and what grows out of it in boxes to the left and right, linked to the bulb by rays (an idea and its consequences)
